heading: When to reach for something else
text:
## When to reach for something else [LSCO.6]

| If you need | DS is not it. Reach for |
|---|---|
| SQL over years of history | a database; DS can call into it |
| Streaming analytics on high-volume data | Flink / Spark / Kafka Streams; DS reacts to their output |
| Running an ML model | an inference server; DS orchestrates via `call` |
| Long-running human-in-the-loop workflow | Temporal / Airflow; DS handles the moment, not the day |
| Arbitrary scripting glue | Python / Bash; DS refuses to become scripting |
| Full CEP pattern language | Esper; DS's temporal surface is pragmatic, not general |
| General-purpose rule engine with imperative extensibility | a general-purpose production-system shell; DS deliberately narrows it |
| Visual flow-based programming | Node-RED / HA automations UI; DS is text, composable, testable |
